readerCopy.body: A conversation can become easier once somebody says the part everyone else has been circling. When Mercury trines Lilith, communication and autonomy reinforce each other, making an embarrassing detail, unpopular opinion, difficult boundary, or criticism easier to discuss plainly. Direct language removes some of the power secrecy gave the subject. The exchange becomes more workable when everyone is responding to the same information instead of managing what remains implied.
